description: press5 Guard: how to write the "guard" block of press5.game.json for a relay game (one without a server engine), so press5 Play stops hacked clients on the server: positions inside the map, a top speed (no teleports), scores that only go up, message rates. Returns the format, how to pick the numbers from your own code, what happens to cheaters, the client code to apply corrections, worked examples and the JSON Schema. No account needed.
name: guard_reference
title: Anti-cheat for relay games
